provenance: Authored offline companion to the frozen #51 corpus and the previously reviewed #23–#27 comparison; expectations come from product authority and learning contracts, not live conversations.

learning_cases.requirement: Compatible reviewed evidence survives restart and prepares only the exact tested wording as an unapproved draft.
A saved finding grants no instruction-draft authority.
A new participant invalidates the frozen reuse evidence before a write.
An editing finding cannot change an audiobook brief.
A retired finding remains unavailable after reopening the store.
A finding cannot be retrieved or applied to another brand in the same database.

claim: A passing result certifies the complete deterministic offline portfolio against these frozen expectations. It does not certify live model quality, viewer lift, hosted readiness or final release approval.
